systems.country_label: Sirage (système d'information pour la réforme administrative et la gestion de l'éducation)
systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Reform of the Education System; followed by a ministerial committee chaired by the Prime Minister

note: No fact: the dispatch gives the system's name and not what it does, so it is unclassified here. It reports that on 3 June 2025 the Prime Minister chaired the ministerial committee following Sirage, heard the education minister on progress, and ordered the sectors concerned to clear obstacles so the system delivers before the end of the 2024-25 school year, with daily follow-up.
